entries.name: Human
entries.description: The registered living of the Warrens. Adaptable: +25% XP, +1 starting attribute point, and bonus talent points at levels 3 and 6.

entries.name: Revenant
entries.description: One of the catalogued dead who refused the record. Hard to kill twice, slow to mend: healing works at half strength. Resists Cold (+50%) and Void (+25%), vulnerable to Radiant (-25%).

entries.name: Cambion
entries.description: Born of a contract signed beneath the Geometry. Their blows find the gaps in any armor. Resists Fire (+50%) and Void (+25%), vulnerable to Cold (-25%).

entries.name: Ash-Marked
entries.description: Scoured in the Sun-House flues until fire answered back. Immune to embers; burning mends +1 HP/turn and fire blows deal +1 damage.

entries.name: Veil-Touched
entries.description: Long dwellers along the Ophite seams. Immune to Monopolized Sight and passively spots hidden traps and secret doors.

entries.name: Iron-Vowed
entries.description: Forged to carry sealed decrees without flinching. Immune to Pinned and gains +1 Subjugation threshold, at a slight step cost.

entries.name: Unrecorded
entries.description: Struck off every census before birth. Foes miss 10% more often and notice 20% less easily.

entries.name: Debt-Sworn
entries.description: Carries an open tally in blood and breath. Working a Relic or suffering a Chain restores +2 class resource and +1 HP.
